title: More Lead Crafts
body:
# Description
Tired of searching for **slimes** or **wandering traders**? MLC adds **2 new lead crafts**, using **all string** OR instead of a slimeball, a **honey potion**.

# Crafts
![craft using all string](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e7d7150ba5e8350e9cf147a77c8a777c0dfcfb3c_0.webp)
Craft using only string. Note: **only crafts 1 lead**.

![craft using honey bottle](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1b3370830b2bb088f35487c679cf9cc5ab1591cf_0.webp)
Craft using honey bottle. Note: **crafts 2 lead**.

### In vanilla 1.21.6, the original lead recipe has been replaced, replacing the slime ball with string. And yes, it does give 2 lead, so this datapack won't really have a point in 1.21.6+.
